card.name: And after strong intensity adjectives
card.fires_on: The word "and" (or "and/or") right after an intensity adjective such as marked, profound, strong, substantial or high. It sits before a second descriptor like prolonged or moderate.

modes.label: Intensity adjective then and
modes.description: "and" directly after marked, strong, profound, substantial or high, linking to a second effect descriptor.
modes.example: Marked<< and>> potentially prolonged systemic hypotension up to

modes.label: And/or after profound
modes.description: The "/or" part of "and/or" following an intensity adjective and "and".
modes.example: /or immature organ function and is also vulnerable to profound and<</or>> prolonged respiratory effects of midazol

card.writes: It suppresses words for large size or amount, such as substantial and huge. This suggests the intensity has already been stated and no further size word is needed.
card.plain: It marks the small linking "and" that follows a strength word like marked or profound, just before a second descriptor.
